content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: regressing (main lifts: 0 up, 3 flat, 2 down).
Sessions: 6. Sets: 84 (last week 84).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 80 kg x 8 (last week 82.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM down 3%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 72.5 kg x 8 (last week 72.5 kg x 8), flat (1 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 115 kg x 5 (last week 120 kg x 5), estimated 1RM down 4.2%, 8 sets this week
- Romanian Deadlift: 92.5 kg x 8 (last week 92.5 kg x 8), flat (1 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
- Overhead Press: 47.5 kg x 8 (last week 47.5 kg x 8), flat (1 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
No new records.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 18 (last week 18), Back 23 (above the range; last week 23), Front delts 15 (last week 15), Side delts 10 (last week 10), Rear delts 10 (last week 10), Quads 14 (last week 14), Hamstrings 12 (last week 12), Glutes 22 (above the range; last week 22), Biceps 13 (last week 13), Triceps 15 (last week 15), Calves 2 (last week 2).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: not set.
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- deload (priority 100). Advice: Plan one lighter week: the same exercises at about half of each lift's sets this period (listed above) and clearly lighter weights, then build back up. If the note mentions sleep or stress, suggest looking at it; don't claim it is the cause.
    - data {"lifts":"Barbell Bench Press, Barbell Back Squat","liftsZh":"槓鈴臥推、深蹲","count":2,"totalSets":84}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
